description: Oilcan 1 on channel 1 and Polyperc 1 on channel 2 play the same groove for four bars at 90 BPM, straight in bars 1 and 2 and swung in bars 3 and 4. Oilcan plays MIDI 36 on steps 1 and 9, MIDI 38 on steps 5 and 13 and MIDI 37 on steps 2, 6, 10 and 14, all at velocity 80. Polyperc plays MIDI 48 on steps 1 and 9 and MIDI 55 on steps 4 and 12 at velocity 60. In bars 3 and 4 both channels carry Swing 25, so every second step of a pair lands a quarter of a step late, about 0.04 seconds, while the first step of each pair stays on the grid. Listen for the small 37 hits and the 55 bass notes starting to trail the beat at bar 3, about 5.3 seconds in; the 36, 38 and 48 downbeats do not move.
synchronization: Observed framebuffer/grid sampled against host monotonic recording time; not sample-exact or physical-norns calibration.
title: Straight, then swung
